body:
Fixed 422 'no animation found in this file' error that blocked importing rigged meshes with no baked animation (real founder upload: Mannequin_F.glb). Migration made tick_rate/duration_ticks/num_channels/content_hash/gband_data/manifest_json nullable in nock_animations; anim_store.go CreateAnimation now requires only one of mesh/skeleton/animation; gltf_convert.go ImportGLTFBytes builds animation fields conditionally. Frontend updated with plain-language mesh/rig/animation explanation for a non-industry founder. New regression tests cover the exact bug shape (mesh-only .glb import via HTTP). Live-verified: rebuilt+redeployed iduna binary, migration applied, pre-existing UAL2_Standard_RM row survived. Commit 7abfc4d.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK animation repository accepts mesh/skeleton-only glTF imports
